
Lojban quarterly journal published by [[jbocre: The Logical Language Group|The Logical Language Group]]; 18 issues appeared between July 1986 (as ''Me la Uacintyn Loglytuan'', the Washington D.C. [[jbocre: Loglan|Loglan]] journal) and June 1993.

Unformatted versions are available at the Lojban web site: [http://www.lojban.org/files/jl/]

''Someone HTML-ising them and putting them on-line would be doing the world a great favour. Warning: Most of them have running unseparated columns in .txt files; it won't be straightforward.''
